nodes.text: Let $A\subset\mathbb{N}$ be the set of cubes. Is it true that\[1_A\ast 1_A(n) \ll (\log n)^{O(1)}?\]

#829 : [Er83] number theory Mordell proved that\[\limsup_{n\to \infty} 1_A\ast 1_A(n)=\infty\]and Mahler [Ma35b] proved\[1_A\ast 1_A(n) \gg (\log n)^{1/4}\]for infinitely many $n$. Stewart [St08] improved this to\[1_A\ast 1_A(n) \gg (\log n)^{11/13}.\] Additional thanks to : msellke Proof expositions (0) If you would like to contribute an exposition of a proof related to this problem, please message a moderator or leave your exposition as a comment.
